props.gloss_en: the rocks that are included with the field occupy at most an area sown with four kav
the four-kav area of rocks is included only when dispersed through an area sown with five kav
the rocks are included only when dispersed through the majority of the field
a solitary rock, even of minimal size, is not measured with the field
a rock adjacent to the field boundary, even of minimal size, is not measured with the field

questions.gloss_en: the majority of the rocks lie in the smaller part of the field and their minority in its larger part: are they sufficiently dispersed?
rocks dispersed through the greater part of the field in a ring: are they measured with it?
rocks arranged in a row: are they measured with the field?
rocks arranged as an angle: are they measured with the field?
rocks arranged as a crooked path: are they measured with the field?
earth intervenes between a rock and the boundary: does it cease to count as boundary-adjacent?
earth below and rock above, or earth above and rock below: is the formation measured with the field?
